parameters.jsonBody: ={{ {model: $env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'smollm2:1.7b', stream:false, format:'json', prompt:'Analyze the following business inquiry. Return JSON with category (Sales, Support, Partnership, Other), priority (Low, Normal, High, Urgent), score integer 0-100, sentiment, summary, suggestedReply and priorityReason, intent (short description of the contact goal). Never claim any message was sent. Subject: '+$node['Load lead'].json.subject+' Message: '+$node['Load lead'].json.message} }}

parameters.jsCode:
const lead=$node['Load lead'].json; let result; let mode='AI'; try { const out=JSON.parse($json.response); const cats=['Sales','Support','Partnership','Other'], priorities=['Low','Normal','High','Urgent']; if(!cats.includes(out.category)||!priorities.includes(out.priority)||!Number.isFinite(out.score)||out.score<0||out.score>100||!['sentiment','summary','suggestedReply','priorityReason','intent'].every(k=>typeof out[k]==='string'&&out[k].trim())) throw new Error('invalid model output'); result={category:out.category,priority:out.priority,score:Math.round(out.score),sentiment:out.sentiment.slice(0,80),summary:out.summary.slice(0,500),suggestedReply:out.suggestedReply.slice(0,2000),priorityReason:out.priorityReason.slice(0,300),intent:out.intent.slice(0,160)}; } catch { mode='Demo Mode'; const t=(lead.subject+' '+lead.message).toLowerCase(); const category=/price|pricing|quote|buy|purchase|demo|sales|plan|cost|trial/.test(t)?'Sales':/bug|issue|help|support|broken|error|problem|login/.test(t)?'Support':/partner|partnership|integrat|collaborat/.test(t)?'Partnership':'Other'; const priority=/urgent|asap|immediately|outage|blocked|critical/.test(t)?'Urgent':/soon|deadline|today|important/.test(t)?'High':/question|information|curious/.test(t)?'Low':'Normal'; result={category,priority,score:category==='Sales'?68:category==='Support'?48:35,sentiment:'Neutral',summary:lead.message.slice(0,145),suggestedReply:'Hello,

Thanks for reaching out. Our team has received your inquiry and will follow up shortly.

Best,
The team',priorityReason:'Local deterministic fallback used because model output was unavailable.',intent:lead.subject.slice(0,160)}; } return [{json:{leadId:lead.id,analysis:result,mode}}];
